standard.summary: 训练前用经验 Fisher 信息扫描各层对任务的敏感度，自动给出"建议层 +
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Before training, scans each layer's sensitivity to the task with empirical Fisher information and proposes suggested layers plus
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 训练前用经验 Fisher 信息扫描各层对任务的敏感度，自动给出"建议层 + 逐层 rank"水填分配。扫描完成后可一键写回到上面的 Rank 分配策略（fim_profile 模式，逐层精确 rank）。这是独立的预扫描工具，不进入训练主链。

advanced_en.principle: Scans each layer's task sensitivity with the empirical Fisher information before training and automatically allocates "recommended layers + per-layer rank". Once the scan finishes, it can be written back to the Rank allocation policy above in one click (fim_profile mode with exact per-layer ranks). A standalone pre-scan tool; not part of the main training chain.
